nodes.notes: Runs every Monday at midnight. Adjust timing as needed.

nodes.notes: Use for on-demand scraping runs

nodes.name: Set Search Parameters
nodes.notes: Configure industries and locations to scrape

nodes.name: Generate Search Queries
nodes.notes: Creates all industry + location combinations with keywords

nodes.name: Google Maps Text Search
nodes.notes: Initial search to find businesses. Returns place_id for details.

nodes.name: Parse Google Results
nodes.notes: Extracts business data from Google Maps response

nodes.name: Get Place Details
nodes.notes: Fetches phone, website, and detailed info for each business

nodes.name: Merge Place Details
nodes.notes: Combines search results with detailed place information

nodes.name: Yelp Business Search
nodes.notes: Parallel search on Yelp for additional businesses

nodes.name: Parse Yelp Results
nodes.notes: Converts Yelp response to standard lead format

nodes.name: Merge All Sources
nodes.notes: Combines Google Maps and Yelp results

nodes.name: Deduplicate Leads
nodes.notes: Removes duplicate businesses, merges data from multiple sources

nodes.name: Filter: Must Have Website
nodes.notes: DISQUALIFIER: No website = skip (per your criteria)

nodes.name: Hunter.io Email Finder
nodes.notes: Finds email addresses from business website domain

nodes.name: Parse Hunter Results
nodes.notes: Extracts owner email and name from Hunter.io response

nodes.name: Apollo.io Enrichment
nodes.notes: Enriches company data with Apollo.io

nodes.name: Merge Apollo Data
nodes.notes: Adds Apollo enrichment data to lead record

nodes.name: Scrape Website
nodes.notes: Fetches website HTML for brand analysis

nodes.name: Analyze Website & Extract Social
nodes.notes: Extracts social media links and analyzes website quality for scoring

nodes.name: Lead Scoring Algorithm
nodes.notes: LNL Custom Scoring: Brand Gap detection, luxury targeting, product recommendations

nodes.name: Filter Low Score Leads
nodes.notes: Only keep leads with score >= 30

nodes.name: Save to Google Sheets
nodes.notes: Backup lead tracker in Google Sheets

nodes.name: Create HubSpot Contact
nodes.notes: Creates contact in HubSpot CRM

nodes.name: Create HubSpot Deal
nodes.notes: Creates deal in LNL Sales Pipeline

nodes.name: Update HubSpot Custom Properties
nodes.notes: Adds custom LNL scoring properties to contact

nodes.name: Filter Hot Leads
nodes.notes: Identify hot leads for immediate notification

nodes.name: Email Hot Lead Alert
nodes.notes: Sends email notification for hot leads

assignments.name: scrape_summary
assignments.value: =Lead generation complete. Processed {{ $('Deduplicate Leads').all().length }} unique businesses. {{ $('Filter Low Score Leads').all().length }} qualified leads saved.

nodes.name: Set Summary
nodes.notes: Final summary of scraping run

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: "You are an email extraction specialist. Given a business name and website URL, determine the most likely business contact email address. Return ONLY the email address, nothing else. If you cannot determine one with confidence, return exactly: NONE

Business: " + $json.business_name + "
Website: " + ($json.website || "") + "
Domain: " + (($json.website || "").match(/https?://([^/]+)/)?.[1] || "") }] }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: "You are a business lead researcher for LNL Group, a growth architecture studio. Search for " + $json.keyword + " businesses in " + $json.location + ".

Return a JSON array of up to 15 businesses. Each object must have these exact keys:
- business_name (string)
- address (string)
- phone (string or empty)
- website (string URL or empty)
- rating (number 1-5 or null)
- review_count (number or 0)

Only include real, currently operating businesses. Prefer businesses with websites. Return ONLY the JSON array, no markdown, no explanation." }] }], tools: [{ google_search: {} }], generationConfig: { maxOutputTokens: 4000, temperature: 0.3 } }) }}

nodes.name: Has Valid Email?
nodes.notes: Guards HubSpot from receiving leads without email. Only passes leads with non-empty email.

nodes.name: Aggregate Hot Leads
nodes.notes: Aggregates all hot leads into a single digest email to prevent SMTP rate limiting
